विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः (यन्त्र-स्वरः)

या᳓ श्येता᳓क्षी᳓ कृष्ण᳓वाला कृष्ण᳓शफा न᳓ त᳓या क्रीणीया᳓द्वतं᳓ वा᳓ अस्या᳓ एत᳓त्प᳓रिपिष्टं पितृदेवत्या᳙ सा᳓ प्रमा᳓युकस्स्याद्या᳓ वि᳓रूपा न᳓ त᳓या क्रीणीया᳓द्वा᳓र्त्रघ्नी सा᳓ जिनाति वा जीयते ।

सर्वाष् टीकाः
Gemini 3.8 Flash

One with white eyes, black tail, and black hooves—with such a one he should not purchase.
What is struck of her is ground to dust.
She belongs to the fathers.
He would be likely to die.
One that is two-coloured—with such a one he should not purchase.
She is Vārtraghnī [destructive of enemies].
Either he overcomes or he is overcome.

मूलम्

या श्येताक्षी कृष्णवाला कृष्णशफा न तया क्रीणीयाद्वतं वा अस्या एतत्परिपिष्टं पितृदेवत्या सा प्रमायुकस्स्याद्या विरूपा न तया क्रीणीयाद्वार्त्रघ्नी सा जिनाति वा जीयते

सोमक्र᳓यण्या तृतीयसवन᳓म᳓वरुध्यं᳓ पश᳓वो वै᳓ तृतीयसवनं᳓ य᳓द्ग᳓वा क्रीणा᳓ति ते᳓नैव᳓ तृती᳓यँ स᳓वनम᳓वरु᳓न्द्वे᳓ रो᳓हिते च᳓र्मन्मिमीते त᳓स्माद्रोहितरूपं᳓ पश᳓वो भू᳓यिष्ठा न᳓ विचेतवा᳓ अ᳓नुमन्येत न᳓ विचीयमानस्यो᳓पद्रष्टा᳓ स्यात् ।

सर्वाष् टीकाः
Gemini 3.8 Flash

By the cow for purchasing Soma the third pressing is to be obtained.
Cattle indeed are the third pressing.
Because he purchases with a cow,
by that alone he obtains the third pressing.
He measures [Soma] on a red hide.
Therefore cattle are mostly of red form.
He should not consent to its being picked apart.
He should not be an onlooker of it while being picked apart.

सर्वाष् टीकाः
Gemini 3.8 Flash

‘You are swift,’ [he says].
Speech indeed is the cow for purchasing Soma;
for by speech one hastens this way and that.
Looking at the cow for purchasing Soma, he offers an oblation.
Speech indeed is the cow for purchasing Soma;
looking at her, he grasps her.
‘Held by the mind,’ [he says];
for by the mind speech is held.
‘Pleasing to Viṣṇu,’ [he says].
Viṣṇu indeed is the sacrifice;
he makes her pleasing to the sacrifice.

मूलम्
